column1: # Measured: per-query calls of the clustering of two releases, one row per part (card C-22).
# Host wilkcomp02.ccbb.utexas.edu, 2026-11-11, MMseqs2 18.8cc5c, read-only copy of run records and cut records.
#   /tmp/if2453/r10/root/l2/cluster_plan/release=rN.3/*.cut.json (parts: cpu_min = the estimate that was used, keys, units).
# rC.1b (2,053,075 proteins, the same stages S1,P1 as rN.1b, a scratch-root build): the same files under
# Both ran before card B-43 (every prefilter part rebuilt the target's table). Columns:
#   est_old_cpu_min  the cut record's estimate (the share of the release's one-process estimate, plus the part overhead)
#   cpu_min          measured CPU-minutes of the step's run record (`cpu_min`; the call's own step or its part's step)
#   queries          keys of the split input; units = residues (prefilter) or entry bytes (the others) of the part
#   targets          prefilter only, derived: the cut record's overhead_cpu_min x 60 / (12.44 / 59,000), rounded
#   one_process_rest  row of every clustering step that is not a per-query call (plan, cuts, kmermatcher, clust, ...,
#                    cluster): the clustering's records less the per-query rows; tokens .. catalog are not clustering
